source.title: Keystone metro cost factor (BLS OEWS wages, see README cost method)

factor.note: MSA 21340 El Paso, TX: labour index L=0.731, materials M=1.0. 5/5 trades (OEWS May 2024 via O*NET Texas local-wages search extracts). Ratios to US: 47-2031 0.671; 47-2111 0.747; 47-2152 0.768; 47-2061 0.748; 49-9021 0.773. L = 0.731; factor = 0.40*0.731 + 0.60*1.00 = 0.89. M=1.00 (default, no public citable reason to adjust).

cost.method: Factor = 0.40*L + 0.60*M, rounded to 2 decimals. L = weighted mean of (metro annual median wage / US national annual median wage) for SOC 47-2031 Carpenters (0.30), 47-2111 Electricians (0.20), 47-2152 Plumbers/Pipefitters/Steamfitters (0.20), 47-2061 Construction Laborers (0.20), 49-9021 HVAC Mechanics/Installers (0.10), from BLS OEWS; weights renormalised over occupations available for the MSA. M = materials index, 1.00 for all Texas metros (no public citable reason to adjust); qualitative materials notes per MSA. Wave 2 (2026-10-11): all five trades retrieved from O*NET Texas local-wages pages (OEWS May 2024) via search extracts (Secondary); HVAC missing for 28660, 47380, 46340, 17780 (weights renormalised there). provisional removed for every MSA with >=4 trades.

plainLanguage: El Paso builds homes under the 2021 International Residential Code with local changes. El Paso is mapped in a moderate earthquake zone (Seismic Design Category C); a detached single-family house is exempt from the extra IRC earthquake rules, but attached townhomes are not. Design wind is 115 mph, snow load is tiny (5 psf), and frost depth is shallow; footings still go at least 12 inches down. In the common R-3 district, keep the house 20 ft from the front, 5 ft from each side and 20 ft from the back, and front plus back yards together must be at least 50 ft. Height is limited to 35 ft and lot coverage to about half the lot. Permit fees are set by square footage, not value. In newer areas on the Northeast, Westside and Eastside, El Paso Water charges an impact fee of about $1,900-2,100 for a normal house meter. Home fire sprinklers are not required.
